products.name: Black Pepper
products.description: Celebrated in global trade as the 'King of Spices', Indian black pepper from the Malabar coast is harvested from mature berries and sun-dried to deep wrinkled peppercorns. Renowned for its sharp, penetrating heat and rich piperine character.
products.characteristics: Bold whole berries, robust pungency, complex piney undertones, natural volatile aromatic compounds.
products.applications: Seasonings, meat processing, culinary spice blends, table grinders, industrial food preparation.
products.packaging: 25kg / 50kg multi-wall paper bags, double HDPE bags, or buyer-specified export packing.

products.name: White Pepper
products.description: Produced from fully ripened pepper berries with the outer pericarp gently removed through controlled water soaking and washing. Delivers an earthy, subtle warmth with a clean, light presentation.
products.characteristics: Smooth creamy-white berries, mellow earthy pungency, clean color profile for pale dishes.
products.applications: Light sauces, cream soups, fine culinary dining, Asian broths, delicate seafood seasonings.
products.packaging: 25kg / 50kg multi-wall bags with polyethylene moisture barrier liner.

products.name: Green Cardamom
products.description: Renowned as the 'Queen of Spices', Indian green cardamom thrives in the high-elevation rainforests of Kerala's Cardamom Hills. The three-sided pods enclose dark aromatic seeds with an intense sweet-citrus and camphoraceous profile.
products.characteristics: Vibrant green pods, intense natural fragrance, high seed-to-pod ratio, rich aromatic profile.
products.applications: Confectionery, baking, Arabic and Turkish coffee blends, tea infusions, curry powders, masala blends.
products.packaging: 5kg & 10kg master cartons with protective vacuum liners or 25kg bulk containers.

products.name: Cinnamon
products.description: True cinnamon harvested from the delicate inner bark of evergreen trees cultivated in southern India. Layered into fragile, paper-thin quills with a sweet, refined aroma and warm, subtle flavor.
products.characteristics: Multi-layered fragile quills, sweet refined aroma, delicate warm flavor.
products.applications: Bakery, pastry, dessert infusions, spiced beverages, savory stews, herbal tea formulations.
products.packaging: 10kg / 25kg export master cartons or bundled quills per buyer requirements.

products.name: Cloves
products.description: Unopened flower buds hand-picked at peak maturity and carefully dried to a deep reddish-brown. Recognizable by their intact crown heads and strong, sweet-spicy aroma.
products.characteristics: Intact flower heads, deep reddish-brown color, pungent sweet warmth, full appearance.
products.applications: Meat brining, pickling, mulled beverages, curry seasonings, industrial food formulations.
products.packaging: 10kg & 25kg multi-wall corrugated cartons with food-grade poly liners.

products.name: Turmeric
products.description: Sourced from premier Indian turmeric regions, including Kerala's Alleppey belt and the famous turmeric trading hub of Erode, Tamil Nadu. Carefully cured, dried, and polished rhizomes prized for vibrant yellow-orange color and earthy aroma.
products.characteristics: Vibrant yellow-orange interior, characteristic earthy aroma, strong natural pigmenting quality.
products.applications: Curry bases, food seasoning, natural food coloring, functional food blends, beverage preparations.
products.packaging: 25kg / 50kg double HDPE bags, multi-wall paper sacks, or bulk bags.

products.name: Red Chilli
products.description: Sun-dried whole Indian red chillies sourced from major southern growing regions. Known across international food processing and spice packing markets for deep natural colour value and clean, dependable heat.
products.characteristics: Crisp sun-dried whole pods, vibrant red colour, balanced pungency, stems intact or stemless.
products.applications: Curry powders, hot sauces, seasoning blends, culinary paste manufacturing, retail packaging.
products.packaging: 10kg, 25kg & 40kg gunny / woven polypropylene sacks or pressed bales.

products.name: Dried Ginger
products.description: Sun-dried ginger rhizomes celebrated historically in maritime trade as 'Cochin Ginger'. Appreciated for their warm pungent bite, fibrous density, and clean citrus-toned warmth.
products.characteristics: Firm unbleached whole rhizomes, clean warming bite, low moisture content.
products.applications: Gingerbread, beverage brewing, tea blends, confectionery, spice seasonings, baking.
products.packaging: 25kg / 50kg natural jute or woven polypropylene sacks.

products.name: Nutmeg
products.description: The oval seed found inside the fruit of the nutmeg tree grown extensively across Kerala's fertile river basins. Shelled to reveal a dense, furrowed kernel with a warm, sweet, nutty aroma.
products.characteristics: Dense oval kernel, intricate internal marbling, warm nutty aroma, sound sound-clean grade.
products.applications: Bakery, dairy desserts, savory sauces, cheese dishes, sausage seasonings, garam masala blends.
products.packaging: 25kg / 50kg multi-wall kraft paper bags or sound jute bags.

products.name: Mace
products.description: The delicate, lacy reddish-orange aril enveloping the nutmeg shell. When dried, it turns a warm golden-amber, offering a fragrant profile similar to nutmeg but with refined, lighter floral nuances.
products.characteristics: Lacy intact blades, brilliant orange-amber hue, delicate aromatic profile, gentle sweetness.
products.applications: Fine baking, clear broths, delicate charcuterie, gourmet seasoning blends, confectionery.
products.packaging: 10kg & 15kg cartons with protective moisture barrier liners.

products.name: Star Anise
products.description: Distinctive star-shaped fruit consisting of boat-shaped carpels enclosing glossy seeds. Offers a sweet, licorice-like aroma prized across international cuisine, tea blending, and baking.
products.characteristics: Symmetrical star shape, reddish-brown color, distinct licorice-anise aroma, sweet warmth.
products.applications: Five-spice formulations, pho broths, braised savory dishes, chai tea blends, confectionery.
products.packaging: 10kg / 15kg export master cartons with protective poly lining.

ports.name: Cochin Port
ports.type: All-weather natural deep-water port with dedicated International Container Transshipment Terminal (ICTT Vallarpadam)
ports.details: India's premier maritime spice gateway on the Arabian Sea. Equipped with full commercial container handling, bulk cargo berths, and direct global liner connectivity.
ports.spiceExportRole: Primary commercial gateway used for maritime spice export shipments from Kerala.

ports.name: Vizhinjam Port
ports.details: Strategic deep-water transshipment facility located close to international east-west shipping channels, equipped for ultra-large container vessels.
ports.spiceExportRole: Modern deep-water transshipment infrastructure enhancing South India's maritime export capabilities.

ports.name: Beypore Port
ports.type: Riverine coastal port & historic trading wharf
ports.details: Historic maritime hub near the mouth of the Chaliyar River, handling regional coastal cargo, passenger traffic to Lakshadweep, and lighterage vessels.
ports.spiceExportRole: Historic North Kerala trading port connecting Malabar coastal commerce.

ports.name: Kollam Port
ports.type: Coastal cargo port with modern wharf facilities
ports.details: All-weather coastal port handling general bulk cargo, raw cashew shipments, and domestic container feeder services along the southwest coast.
ports.spiceExportRole: Southern Kerala coastal trade infrastructure with customs clearance capability.

ports.name: Azhikkal Port
ports.details: Situated at the mouth of the Valapattanam River in North Malabar, supporting coastal container feeder movements, cement, and regional trade.
ports.spiceExportRole: Regional North Malabar maritime facility supporting coastal connectivity.

ports.name: Neendakara Port
ports.type: Estuarine port at the confluence of Ashtamudi Lake and the Arabian Sea
ports.details: Historically significant coastal port and major marine hub with facilities for intermediate vessels and coastal navigation.
ports.spiceExportRole: Part of the notified port network administered by Kerala Maritime Board.

ports.name: Alappuzha Port
ports.type: Historic open roadstead port with historic sea pier
ports.details: Celebrated historic port of Travancore that previously handled coir and spice exports; currently earmarked for maritime tourism and coastal revitalization.
ports.spiceExportRole: Historic heritage port of the Central Travancore spice and coir trade.

ports.name: Kayamkulam Port
ports.details: Notified port area located around the Kayamkulam backwaters and barrier beach, with ongoing maritime planning under KMB.
ports.spiceExportRole: Notified port location in Kerala's maritime network.

ports.name: Valiyathura Port
ports.details: Historic pier that served southern Kerala before modern containerization; now preserved as a coastal landmark with no commercial cargo operations.
ports.spiceExportRole: Historic heritage port site in southern Kerala.

ports.name: Ponnani Port
ports.type: Estuarine tidal port at the mouth of Bharathapuzha
ports.details: Historic Malabar maritime town with a notified port area undergoing phased commercial development for coastal cargo and small craft handling.
ports.spiceExportRole: Notified port infrastructure under the Kerala Maritime Board development plan.

ports.name: Vatakara Port
ports.details: Notified coastal port location in northern Kerala, historically active in coastal timber and produce lighterage.
ports.spiceExportRole: Notified non-major port under Kerala state jurisdiction.

ports.name: Kozhikode Port
ports.type: Historic open roadstead anchorage & sea piers
ports.details: The legendary 'City of Spices' port where historic spice galleons anchored. Modern commercial cargo operations in the district are handled at Beypore.
ports.spiceExportRole: The cradle of Malabar maritime spice trade history; commercial operations handled at nearby Beypore.

ports.name: Thalassery Port
ports.details: Famous colonial spice port on the Malabar coast with an iconic sea pier; currently inactive for commercial cargo vessel movements.
ports.spiceExportRole: Historic center of northern Malabar spice trade.

ports.name: Kannur Port
ports.details: Notified port area along the northern coast. Most regional maritime traffic is accommodated at Azhikkal Port.
ports.spiceExportRole: Notified non-major port within the Kerala Maritime Board network.

ports.name: Neeleswaram Port
ports.details: Notified port area located near the confluence of local river systems in Kasaragod district, planned for future coastal utilization.
ports.spiceExportRole: Part of the notified port framework of northern Kerala.

ports.name: Manjeswaram Port
ports.details: Located at the northern border of Kerala, designated as a notified minor port under state maritime jurisdiction.
ports.spiceExportRole: Northernmost notified maritime location in Kerala.

ports.name: Kasaragod Port
ports.type: Riverine estuary port at Chandragiri river mouth
ports.details: Notified coastal port area handling local craft movements; included in state maritime development surveys.
ports.spiceExportRole: Notified minor port in northern Kerala.

ports.name: Kodungalloor Port
ports.type: Estuarine port near ancient Muziris trade basin
ports.details: Located near the legendary ancient spice trade capital of Muziris; notified as a non-major port for coastal and riverine craft integration.
ports.spiceExportRole: Historic epicenter of ancient Roman and Greek spice trade voyages.

content.headline: Connecting Indian Spice Growers Directly With Global Buyers
content.tagline: Rooted in Kerala's legendary spice coast. Serving food manufacturers, brand packagers, and wholesale importers worldwide.
content.paragraph1: India is globally recognized as the historic home and leading producer of the world's most aromatic spices and diverse agricultural goods. Within this vast heritage, the state of Kerala on India's southwest coast has stood for millennia as the premier gateway of the international spice trade.
content.paragraph2: At Auronova Exports, based in Cochin, Kerala, our mission is to build a direct and dependable bridge between India's spice growers and overseas commercial buyers. By eliminating unnecessary layers of intermediaries, we offer transparent sourcing, consistent quality grading, and direct container consolidation from Cochin Port.

home_heritage.title: Kerala Heritage & Regional Origins
home_heritage.subtitle: Highlights of regional provenance, Western Ghats terroir, and Erode turmeric.

content.headline: The Rich Diversity of Indian Spices, Anchored in Kerala
content.description: India has enriched global cuisines for thousands of years through diverse agro-climatic zones. Within this vast landscape, Kerala holds a historic preeminence as the primary spice coast, complemented by specialized regional origins such as Erode for turmeric and southern agricultural clusters for whole spices.

regions.desc: Highland mist, elevation above 1,000m, and rich forest loam concentrate high piperine and aromatic cineole oils.
Celebrated across world markets for vibrant yellow-orange color value, distinct earthy pungency, and robust curcumin.
Deep alluvial soils and steady coastal monsoons nurture hand-picked whole cloves, golden mace, and fibrous Cochin ginger.

about_mission_vision.title: Mission, Vision & Core Values
about_mission_vision.subtitle: Company purpose, vision statement, and operational values.

content.missionText: To connect India's spice-growing regions and agricultural producers with international buyers through a direct, transparent, and dependable sourcing approach. We aim to make authentic Indian spices and products more accessible to global markets while building meaningful business relationships between producers and buyers.
content.visionText: To build a trusted bridge between the source of Indian spices and products and the businesses that need them across the world. We envision a more direct and transparent sourcing network where international buyers can access authentic Indian products closer to their origins, with fewer unnecessary intermediaries and a clearer connection to the people and regions behind them.
